meta.title: Source inbox
meta.description: One workbench that archives your own account materials into a local knowledge base: 28 platforms with one-click official entry links, step-by-step guidance after the login page, paste-and-save credential boxes, and a plugin-owned controlled browser that reads your own logged-in pages. Text is stored on disk; large media is kept as a reference with a text shadow. Includes an import wizard, unified schema, dual-track archiving, a sidebar workbench, and 13 agent tools.
